name: vox-pop-embed
description: The Vox Pop embed widget: a drop-in voice-reply recorder for any website. One-way mirror of the Vox Pop monorepo.

scripts.build:packages:embed: npm run build -w @vox-pop/design-tokens && npm run build -w @vox-pop/brand-ui
scripts.build: npm run build:packages:embed && npm run build -w @vox-pop/embed
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages:embed && npm run dev -w @vox-pop/embed
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages:embed && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run build:packages:embed && npm run test --workspaces
